The hide stands on the west bank some 2,500 units west-south-west of the woven weir (six Saxhleel fences across the creek below the camp, a log boom above them), beside a lone dead swamp tree, with a crate for the note, jars beside the quest's own jar of sap and the sap-takers' pack. The three Unbound, the note and the jar are the quest's, at their spots by hand.
